test_title: PYST 56: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, L, N, S, T and Z are seven candidates sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order), for a group discussion. L is sitting third to the left of N. N is sitting exactly between T and B. Z is an immediate neighbour of B and is sitting third to the left of S. Z is also an immediate neighbour of A. Who is sitting second to the left of N?
solution:
Given, A, B, L, N, S, T and Z are seven candidates sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order), for a group discussion.

L is sitting third to the left of N.

N is sitting exactly between T and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b664faa74a63a382899177085bf1eae8471a703849bc006b0d6238deb45ebdf4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49a550d92efec1459ebbeaaf7c6e10be05b020ed6dbda6c1c57ce38a5924416d.png] 

Z is an immediate neighbour of B and is sitting third to the left of S.

Z is also an immediate neighbour of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85a7722d67f13c6061da9f8a834d13198bfb02a28be2ca94025a8cc6bd130510.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be3b3f0d7a1552b4f234f335134370d29dc37b10c40fd7d7180e9adee4c7a3fa.png] 

S is sitting second to the left of N.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
